description_en: Updates the HTTP response header modification configuration for a site
description_zh: 更新站点的修改HTTP响应头配置
name: UpdateHttpResponseHeaderModificationRule

parameters.help_en: The site ID. You can call the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation to obtain the site ID
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The configuration ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2867483.html operation to obtain the configuration ID
parameters.name: config_id

parameters.help_en: The rule name. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The rule switch. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: rule_enable

parameters.help_en:
The rule content, which uses a conditional expression to match user requests. This parameter is not required when you add a global configuration. Two scenarios are supported:
Match all incoming requests: set the value to true.
Match specified requests: set the value to a custom expression, for example, (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.name: rule

fields.help_en:
The operation type. Valid values:

add: adds a response header.
del: deletes a response header.
modify: modifies a response header
fields.help_zh:
操作方式。取值范围：

add：添加。
del：删除
modify：变更
fields.name: operation

fields.help_en:
The value type. Valid values:
static: static pattern.
dynamic: dynamic schema
fields.help_zh:
值类型。取值范围：
static：静态模式。
dynamic：动态模式
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The response header modifications. Three operation types are supported: add, delete, and modify
parameters.help_zh: 修改响应头，支持添加、删除、修改三种操作方式
parameters.name: response_header_modification

parameters.help_en: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行
parameters.name: sequence
